mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.status AS status, a.identifier AS username, a.credential AS password FROM sys_user u JOIN user_auth a ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.identifier = #{username} AND a.auth_type = 'password' LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort_order

SELECT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.perms, p.name AS parentName FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_menu p ON m.parent_id = p.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type = 'F' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
